pages.text: The Ember King had taken the Rainbow Candle. Pearl Castle needed more magic.
Roshan wanted to help her home shine again. But where could she begin?
A wing-chime rang. The moonflower door opened. Beyond it lay a rainbow path.
Roshan followed the Rainbow Skyway. At the far end stood the Butterfly House.
The house was beautiful. But its seven baby butterflies were missing.
They had lost their way. Little wings fluttered here and there.
Roshan found the littlest one beside a leaf. "I will help you get home."
She found another. And another. Soon all seven were home together.
The little butterflies rested. "You look hungry," said Roshan. "Let's have a picnic!"
But the garden's fruit tree was not well. Its leaves were covered in orange spots.
There was no fruit to share. First, Roshan would help the tree feel better.
She opened her Tree Book. She looked at the tree. Then she looked at its leaf.
Orange spots on the leaf. Orange dots on the spray. The pictures matched!
Roshan cared for the leaves. The butterflies waited close by.
The tree felt better. Its leaves lifted. Pink blossoms opened.
Then fruit grew where the blossoms had been. Apples for the picnic!
Roshan picked the ripe apples. There would be enough to share.
She remembered her work in the castle kitchen. "I can make a butterfly snack!"
First, she washed the fruit. Then she made room for little plates.
She cut small, soft pieces. Little mouths needed little bites.
The butterflies shared the snack. Roshan sat with them. Nobody ate alone.
One butterfly did a happy loop. Another wobbled after it. Roshan laughed.
"Now we can help you!" They showed Roshan the way to the Fairy Fountain.
At the fountain, Roshan's fairy wings shimmered. Up she went!
Over the pond they flew together, past lilies and pools of blue.
The Fairy Flower waited ahead. Its petals were shut tight.
Roshan looked carefully. The butterflies showed her a clear way through.
Sparkle. Sparkle. Roshan sent gentle magic toward the flower.
Little by little, its leaves moved. Its petals began to open.
The Fairy Flower bloomed! Colour and magic filled the pond.
The flower shared a little magic for Pearl Castle. The garden kept its own.
Roshan brought the faerie magic home. There were more friends to meet, and more good things to do together.
